title: SIT ON ME
tagline: A 3D stealth and physics comedy where you play a sentient chair.
stateNote: A hosted copy runs on my Vercel. I haven't played it through.
problem: Humans freak out when a chair scoots, so you hold SPACE to freeze as innocent furniture, then sneak, sabotage rival furniture and evolve across five chairs.
audience: Anyone who likes silly stealth games.
contribution: It is my project, built with WebGL and Three.js. The repository is named 'chairgame'.
worksToday: The README describes red-light-green-light stealth, sabotage and five chair chassis.

involve.headline: Which chair is funniest?
asks: Tell me which chair deserves to be the funniest.
